meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "review writing", "check documentation style", "audit interface copy", or "apply writing guidelines".

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按原文的写作规则(语气、禁用词、标点、代码块等)审查用户指定的文件或匹配模式,并输出带 file:line 的简洁逐文件违规清单。
howto.when: 当用户提出「审查写作」「检查文档风格」「审计界面文案」或「套用写作规范」等要求时触发。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude reviews the user-specified files or matching patterns against the skill's writing rules (voice, banned words, punctuation, code blocks, etc.) and outputs a terse per-file list of violations with file:line references.

Lists issues based on the skill's rules
